chapter: On the road with Guitar Slim
title: Leaving Joe Jones to join Guitar Slim
summary: After Joe Jones fired a bandmate, Ford and Dalton Russo left, and Guitar Slim's manager hired them for 20 dollars a night.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Yeah, because we got in an incident late on over the river there where we all had to leave. Prevost's bass got broke up. And right, that was before I ever thought about leaving. But Joe had a disagreement with one of the guys in the band and he fired him. I said, well if you fired him I'm going to leave too. Dalton. And when he left we went with Guitar Slam then. That was in 54. Who was it? That's how I went with Guitar Slam. Joe Jones. Who was the other guy? Dalton Russo, a trumpet player. Yeah. He played with Tiger. He was with Tiger. That's how we were together. We were like brothers. Dalton Russo? Yeah. We all played together the same. We were roommates. So we both left. Get to our Slam he needed, it's a funny thing, he needed a saxophone player and a trumpet player at the same time. So Jose called him. Jose Hill? Yeah.
Jose called him and said he needed a saxophone player. So he told me about it because I wasn't working at all. And Joe just thought we wouldn't work anywhere.
So I said, he said, I'm taking it.

I said, well I've never been on the road, I'll take it too because I'm not doing it. And Guitar Slam was working at the time. We were getting twenty dollars a night, seven nights a week. And we could get a room for two dollars a night. We could get a meal in cities like New York for a dollar, less than a dollar.
